heroHeadline: Premier League, La Liga, Serie A and Bundesliga Demand FIFA Reform in Rare Joint Statement
heroSubtitle: England's Premier League, Spain's La Liga, Italy's Serie A and Germany's Bundesliga issued a joint statement Sep 25 saying football had 'suffered one of the biggest abuses of power in FIFA's history' over the abandoned $20 billion World Cup stake-sale plan, and questioned whether FIFA's president should hold regulatory, commercial and political power 'without effective checks and balances' — the first time Europe's top domestic leagues have formally weighed in, though they stopped short of demanding Gianni Infantino's resignation. Infantino responded the same day calling for a 'culture of dialogue,' framing a Sep 21 letter proposing a structured governance consultation and an independent external review — due for initial discussion at the Oct 15 FIFA Council meeting in Zurich — as 'doing what is right for the game.'
